goal_level: L3 station-radius GHSL population tile checksum and transform gate
first_wave_rule: Download only selected GHSL tile rows with successful HEAD metadata and recorded size at or below 60 MB; keep all other selected tile rows as blockers.
cache_policy: Raw GHSL ZIP files are stored under air-monitoring/.cache/station-radius-ghsl-population-tiles/ and are not committed; rerun this script to rehydrate them from public GHSL tile URLs.

evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: The previous gate bounded the population denominator URL queue.
Only selected rows with closed HEAD metadata and size <= 60 MB are downloaded here.
Downloaded ZIP bodies stay in the ignored cache; hashes are committed.
Checksums support reproducible file custody for downloaded first-wave tiles.
Raster bounds and transforms are inspected before any catchment calculation.
Downloaded rasters must match the routing assumption before the selected-tile method can be frozen.
These selected tiles remain in the queue and must not disappear from the method.
No catchment population, PM2.5 exposure, or map is computed here.

tile_checksum_rows.reader_use: Use downloaded rows as the first-wave checksummed GHSL population denominator custody ledger; do not use blocked rows as denominator evidence.
tile_checksum_rows.blocking_gap: Selected HEAD-failed tiles must still be retried; all downloaded ZIPs need checksum and transform inspection before radius/de-duplication rules can be frozen.
tile_checksum_rows.non_claim: This GHSL population tile checksum gate downloads, hashes, and inspects only selected GHSL tile ZIP files whose HEAD metadata already closed and whose recorded size is within the first-wave custody threshold. It does not download selected HEAD-failed tiles, compute station-radius population, compute PM2.5 exposure, validate same-station joins, freeze radius or de-duplication rules, or promote monitor-grade rows.
